LanguageData.RP_BookButtonTip: Reserve hours of the day for this class. A booked class is tried first when its hour comes, in the room you choose, before the fullest class would take the room and the teacher. When it cannot run, the hour is kept as a miss with its reason; nothing is cancelled and nothing is charged. Who attends and what it costs is the session's, as always.

LanguageData.RP_BookHelp: Click an hour to book or free it. Green hours have eligible inmates whose regime gives them this class's slot; red ones have none (a meal, lockup or other activity instead); an orange bar marks an hour another booked class wants the same room or teacher in (the higher priority goes first). A booked class that cannot run is a miss with its reason, and the automatic scheduler fills the room as it would have.
LanguageData.RP_BookPriorityTip: Of two booked classes that want the same room or teacher in an hour, the higher goes first.
